text:
Emma: Morning — finalizing the demo hub run for CloudNative Summit next week. Key items: speaker order, hardware shuttle, swag courier, and the marketplace announcement window. Can everyone confirm availability and owners?
Jake: Confirmed. Speaker order I propose: Emma intro -> Priya (CloudPartner) demo -> Dan (SI) deep dive -> Mateo Q&A. Any objections?
Olivia: I'll own swag courier + customs. Need final counts + HS codes by Thu COB. Options: FedEx Priority or local courier (cheaper, slower).
Li: AV note: 2x HDMI out, 1x DisplayPort, 1x lapel mic + handheld backup, power strips, and Rack 3 reserved. Network: 200 Mbps burst available. If you need static IP let me know.
Mateo: For live demos we want traffic routed to Dedicated pool A. Ops fallback plan: route to Hosted small-quant model when p95 latency > 250ms. @DeployBot can we automate that policy?
Emma: @DeployBot would that be a simple flag flip or do we need an ops runbook?
DeployBot: Canary scheduled for marketplace listing flip at 2026-06-15T17:00Z (10:00 PDT). Automated rollback scheduled at 17:30Z if error rate > 1% or latency p95 > 400ms. Logs will stream to /canary/marketplace.
Jake: Can we nudge the window to 10:15–10:25 PDT to avoid colliding with the keynote? 10:00 feels tight.
Emma: Yep, shifting OK — please update calendar invite.
Olivia: Swag manifest draft below — need print approval by Tue EOD: 
- T-shirts: 150 (L/XL split), 20 M, 10 S
- Stickers: 700 assorted
- Pins: 200
- Demo magnets: 50
- Giveaways (mini power banks): 40
Also: custom wrap option (+$2/tee) — do we want?
Li: Courier pick-up window Wed 17:00–19:00. I'll book a pallet pickup. Need CN22 + commercial invoice for customs. Use label prefix: RWD-SUMMIT-2365.
Mateo: Hardware list: 2x A10 loaners from EdgeVendor arriving Fri, 1x NVMe spare SSD, 1x 4G fallback router. OPS: confirm we can wire the Dedicated pool to those machines and enable KV cache warmup before 09:30.
Priya: I'll bring a spare SSD and an edge router. EdgeVendor contact: ken@edgevendor.com (cc'd for logistics). I can do a 7-min slide on marketplace integration and demo the plugin flow.
Emma: Quick runbook snippet — please copy into the master run sheet: 
```
Runbook snapshot:
- 09:00 load models on Dedicated A
- 09:30 smoke tests (bench prompts)
- 09:50 speaker mic + AV check
- 10:00 final route dry-run -> Marketplace canary
- 10:15 live demo start (Priya)
- 10:25 handoff to Dan for deep dive
- 10:30 rollback window closes / monitor 10:30–10:45
```
Jake: DevEx — can you prepare 2 short prompts for the smoke tests and a small bench script? Link to repo: https://git.company/redwood/demo-bench. I can PR sample prompts today.
Olivia: Printer needs APPROVED artwork by Tue noon for guaranteed print. If we go custom-wrap add 2 business days. Can someone confirm final logo placement?
Mateo: Budget ok but need final sign-off from Finance. I'll ping Sam and loop back by Thu.
Li: Added courier pickup + customs reminder to the calendar. Will share carrier tracking once booked.
Priya: Rehearsal: Tue 11:00 PT works for me — will rehearse slides + demo flow with Emma and Jake.
SwagCourierBot: Pickup created for Wed 2026-06-10 17:30 PDT. Carrier: FedEx Priority. Tracking: FCX123456789.
Emma: Action items recap: Olivia finalize manifest by Tue, Li confirm courier + CN22 by Wed noon, Mateo confirm ops fallback wiring and KV warm-up by Thu, Jake produce bench prompts and PR by Fri, Priya join rehearsal Tue 11:00 PT. Everyone react when you’ve completed your item. :thumbsup: 
Olivia: Will do. I'll also check custom-wrap cost and post options here. :shipit:
Li: Confirmed carrier slot. Calendar updated.
Mateo: Pinged Sam for budget sign-off.
Jake: I'll update the run sheet and move the canary window to 10:15–10:25 PDT.
Priya: Got it — will be ready for rehearsal.
Emma: Great. If no blockers, I’ll post the final run sheet this Friday and lock the speaker order. Thanks all.
Jake: Noted. Closing loop unless anything else pops up.
Olivia: One last Q — do we want a small QR card that links to the marketplace listing (short link)? I can order print 48 hrs turnaround.
Emma: Yes, please. Make it a shortlink and include UTM params for partner tracking.
SwagCourierBot: Label manifest attached to pickup: RWD-SUMMIT-2365_MANIFEST.pdf (tracking attached).
